verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents APIs for building fully custom verification workflows and for screening "all through one API," so core verification functions are reachable programmatically. Nothing establishes parity with the UI: flow editing, case assignment, and team/role management are described only as dashboard features, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for dashboard flow editing, case routing/assignment and user/role management, an explicit API-parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build fully custom verification workflows using AiPrise APIs for maximum control and flexibility.
Screen adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists in real time - all through one API.
